runtime_components.human_takeover: Cloudflare Dashboard > Browser Run > Live Sessions
runtime_components.session_reuse: disconnect -> private Cloudflare session discovery -> fresh CDP reconnect
runtime_components.residential_fallback: self-hosted persistent browser profile only when cloud/datacenter blocked

remaining_gate.reason: A human must complete one authorized platform login through Cloudflare Browser Run Live Sessions so structured handoff and authenticated-session reuse can be verified end-to-end.
remaining_gate.safe_action: Run the PROMO L2 Browser Run Bridge workflow in handoff mode for a user-owned/authorized platform, then complete login/MFA/CAPTCHA only inside Cloudflare Live Sessions and mark the handoff Done.

readiness_rule: Do not mark READY until a real Browser Run session has been created, structured human takeover has completed, and the authenticated session has been rediscovered and reused from a fresh L2 CDP connection without persisting sensitive session material.
fallback_readiness_rule: For cloud/datacenter-blocked sites, require an online self-hosted residential runner with a platform-isolated persistent profile before marking that platform READY.
